payload.answer:
Please do the following: 

 1. Backup the \Datacap\DotEdit\apps.ini file. If the file does not exist, create a new one or copy it from \Datacap\tmweb.net. 
 2. Open it in notepad.exe or other editor. 
 3. Find the app to be modified (for example [APT]). If it does not exist, create a new section with the application name listed between square brackets. 
 4. Add a new line containing BatchLimit=xxx, where xxx is the number of batches to be displayed. 
 5. Save the file. [S2]

payload.actual_query:
Unable to view batches in DotEdit
Hi all,

Is there any limitation to view batches in Dot Edit client application, because I am unable to see batches with QID more than 1119.

Also unable to see batches with status as "Pending".

source_lineage.excerpt: This is happening because when configuring the workflow in the Administrator tab in Taskmaster Web, the Verify task was assigned to use Multiple programs.- If it is changed to use DotEdit as the program to use for Verify, then you will not see Verify as one of the options in DotScan in the first place, so the current situation will not arise.

Please do the following: 

 1. Backup the \Datacap\DotEdit\apps.ini file. If the file does not exist, create a new one or copy it from \Datacap\tmweb.net. 
 2. Open it in notepad.exe or other editor. 
 3. Find the app to be modified (for example [APT]). If it does not exist, create a new section with the application name listed between square brackets. 
 4. Add a new line containing BatchLimit=xxx, where xxx is the number of batches to be displayed. 
 5. Save the file.

Additional information: 
 * For version 8.1, Fix Pack 1 or newer must be installed. 
 * Increasing the number of batches displayed is known to cause a slowdown in perceived response time due to gathering and formatting of the batch list. 
 * The optimum number will vary due to system conditions, infrastructure and user expectation. 
 * The DotEdit batch list will be slower to display than the batch list in Taskmaster Web, due to architectural differences between the applications.

IO24404 Vscancl.aspx does not show PDF thumbnail. IO24405 If Start Batch Panel fails validation, second time Submit crashes Desktop IO24412 mvscan() scan hangs in tree mode, if folder has less than max docs, and there is a subfolder in it IO24442 Fingerprint positions written to setup DCO even when FPXML is enabled IO24450 Datacap Desktop crashes on Verify when using SystemT extractors and pulling back ALL values into parent and child fields IO24462 Unable to use ISIS scan feature within Datacap 9.0.1 Fastdoc IO24471 When logging off, the running batch should be held even if the user did not hold it manually. IO24495

IO23605 TifMerge_MergeImages creates corrupted tiffs when one of the source image is 32 bit tiff with LZW compression IO24215 FNP8_CreateFolder () does not support / handle error in French IO24223 Mclaim Professional routes DocIntegrity batch to fixup when processed through Rulerunner IO24231 WTS trigger does not invoke NENU.exe to perform maintenance management IO24257 Vendor Lookup to either SQL table or Oracle table returns two unwanted columns IO24369 TMWEB job monitor: if columns are rearranged(the QID is not the leftmost column) selecting the batch number or status will generate the error: Input string was not in a correct format. IO24373 Desktop Verify Batch View does not Refresh when marking an item for Rescan, Review or Delete IO24380 GetBarcodeBP() action no

Copy from Taskmaster server C:\Datacap\Taskmaster\dc_KTF.xml to your local system C:\Datacap\Taskmaster


 1. On client system open a Command Prompt window 
 2. Type
    cd c:\Datacap\Taskmaster 
 3. Then type
    dcskey.exe -i 
 4. If you are still unable to connect then Remove the client system from the domain 
 5. On the client delete the local folder of the domain user 
 6. Reconnect the client to the domain 
 7. Log into client with domain user 
 8. Repeat steps 1 through 4 and connect with DotEdit and DotScan

Grant the user or group the 'Run Task dialog' privilege.


 1. Run Taskmaster Client and login as admin or a user with full rights. 
 2. From the Settings menu select Users (or Groups). 
 3. Highlight the user (or group) to grant the privilege to and check the Run Task dialog box. 
 4. Click Apply, then Done to close the window.

Increase the dispatcher limit to 8192 using the following steps : 


1. Stop the IBM Cognos 10 service

2. Edit the file <c10_install>\webapps\p2pd\WEB-INF\p2pd_deploy_defaults.properties and add the following parameter if it does not exist : 

dispatcher.MaxRequestParameters=8192
